checks: Prompts, four options and four individual rationales translated from effective Japanese, with answer indices unchanged.
Actors, wishes, negation, observation versus inference, reported symptoms versus diagnoses, pending versus completed actions, and passage times retained.
Sixty nonempty Japanese passages translated. Three hundred empty source passages remain empty.
Thirty source figure descriptions translated without creating or changing figures; labels, IDs, positions and scenario-specific quantities retained.

Re-read all explicit healthcare-professional/responsible-person, facility-procedure and individual-plan source fields selected by the targeted Japanese qualifier scan; restored omitted explicit rationale recipients and plan wording where necessary.
Consent is not inferred from a nod, a family request, explanation, preparation or a reply; specific consent remains separate from blanket permission.
The70cm route width is an express condition of Skills04q42, not a universal equipment rule. Skills06q44 retains200ml over30minutes versus200ml overone day.
Review examples do not authorize autonomous medication changes, lifting, posture techniques, fluid increases or procedures from figures alone.
Continuous-prose follow-up repaired clipped English phrases, awkward personal-words wording, paragraph context and punctuation; fragment answer labels were retained where clear.

Compared repeated exact Japanese fields within the mock batch using only ownEnglish drafts. Profession labels, clock-position labels, entrance hall and the all-identical option were normalized. Remaining wording differences are disclosed in the private QA draft if present.
